statement: The public metric amplitude unit carried by the K2 lane is already tiny.
3180 gives the projected Hessian moment in terms of the exterior product.
Combining the 3177 public metric unit and 3180 projected moment maps P_H into a public P2 metric amplitude.
3183 uses A_slip_surface=2|Sigma_H|. If the slip P2 amplitude is compared to the same public P2 metric amplitude, the natural chi_H is fixed.
The 3184 10^-25 suppression target is exactly the metric-unit/projection factor, not an independent tuning demand, under the same-normalization map.
